brief:
A UK-registered company with a Greek owner has become the primary financial backer of Serbia's Israeli drone venture, Middle East Eye reported. The project, which involves manufacturing armed drones, counts among its investors Netanyahu's former lawyer, raising questions about the network of interests shaping the weapons program.

Serbia has positioned itself as a manufacturing hub for Israeli drone technology in Europe, though the full ownership structure and foreign involvement remained opaque until now. The venture brings together a British company, Greek capital, and a lawyer with ties to Netanyahu's government.
title: UK firm, Greek owner bankroll Serbia's Israeli drone project
